# WarmRice

WarmRice is a light theme built on a warm natural palette, recorded with a #faf8f5 background, sage green accents at #7a9e7e and terracotta highlights at #d4a08a. Its README attributes that palette to the Earth Online Survival Manual, states full coverage of the Obsidian interface and typography tuned for Chinese and English, and records the MIT license.

![WarmRice screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jmj-eo/obsidian-warmrice/HEAD/screenshot.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "WarmRice"
    author: "太乙"
    repo:   "jmj-eo/obsidian-warmrice"
    slug:   "warmrice"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/warmrice"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/jmj-eo/obsidian-warmrice"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jmj-eo/obsidian-warmrice/HEAD/screenshot.png"

    modes: ["light"]
}
```
